description: Other countries: the central bank's policy rate (Bank for International Settlements, about 40 central banks, the ECB for euro countries) with the date it last changed and the country's latest yearly inflation. US: today's Treasury yields from the Treasury's daily par yield curve (1 month to 30 years), each next to the latest 12-month inflation (BLS CPI) as a real, after-inflation rate, and optionally the interest a sum would earn at one term. Use for 'where should I keep cash', 'what do T-bills pay', 'is a 5% CD good right now' and similar questions. Not investment advice. Not for what money from a past year is worth today (use check_inflation).

amount.description: Dollar amount to show interest for

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States

term.description: Term for the interest example; default 1 year

name: check_rates
title: Rates check: interest rates now, after inflation
